portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Star Seeker — Windstar's newest and largest yacht — departs on an intimate 7-night Alaska voyage for just 1,000 guests.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A serene sea day as Star Seeker glides through the Inside Passage. With fewer than 1,000 guests aboard, the outdoor deck space is remarkable — the perfect place to watch for whales and eagles.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's stunning capital. Star Seeker's smaller size enables access to areas larger ships can't visit. Take a helicopter glacier tour or whale watch in Auke Bay with Windstar's expert naturalist on board.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: The evocative Gold Rush town at the head of the Lynn Canal. Ride the historic White Pass & Yukon Route Railway through mountain scenery that captivated prospectors and inspires travelers today.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: One of Southeast Alaska's most rewarding ports — a blend of Tlingit heritage and Russian colonial legacy. The sea otter colonies here are among the most accessible in Alaska.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, totem poles, and extraordinarily fresh seafood right from the docks. A floatplane tour to Misty Fjords National Monument is a Windstar favorite.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: Return to Seattle — disembarkation day after an intimate 7-night Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

reviewSnippet: Windstar's small expedition-style ship carries a few hundred guests — closer to the scenery, with a more intimate, yacht-like feel than the big ships.
